title: WS JSON codec generated from the proto descriptor (arch item G)
description: FORWARD SPEC (tail — not yet landed). The WebSocket JSON codec is generated from the proto descriptor set by celnet-proto's build.rs rather than hand-maintained in celnet-server::ws, so a new proto verb needs no hand-written WS arm; the generated codec is wire byte-identical to the current hand codec across the cross-client conformance corpus. The roll-up stays non-active until G ships. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'ws-codec-from-proto'.

assertions.statement: celnet-proto's build.rs generates the WS JSON codec from the proto descriptor set (a generated codec module is emitted at build time), so the WS verb encode/decode is no longer hand-maintained. (Forward target — build.rs does not yet emit a WS codec module.)

The hand-maintained WS dispatch/codec in celnet-server::ws::mod is driven from the build.rs-generated codec, so adding a proto verb requires no hand-written WS arm. (Forward target — ws::mod::dispatch is still hand-maintained on main.)
The generated codec is wire byte-identical to the current hand codec across the cross-client conformance corpus — generation changes the source of the codec, not the bytes on the wire.
